entries.en: Our most loyal customers kept visiting while the street was under repair.
entries.zh: 街道施工期间，我们最忠实的顾客仍然一直来光顾。

entries.en: I became suspicious when the supposed collector could not name a single painting.
entries.zh: 那个自称收藏家的人连一幅画的名字都说不出，我开始怀疑起来。

entries.en: The novel opens with a fatal accident on a remote mountain road.
entries.zh: 小说以偏远山路上的一起致命事故开篇。

entries.en: The hotel offered to compensate us for the missing luggage.
entries.zh: 酒店提出就行李丢失一事补偿我们。

entries.en: He raised one eyebrow when he saw the enormous cake.
entries.zh: 看到那个巨大的蛋糕时，他扬起了一边眉毛。

entries.en: Stack the empty crates against the wall to leave the doorway clear.
entries.zh: 把空箱子靠墙叠放，别堵住门口。

entries.en: It was cruel to laugh at a child who was trying so hard.
entries.zh: 嘲笑一个如此努力的孩子是很刻薄的。

entries.en: The exhibition celebrates a pioneer of underwater photography.
entries.zh: 这个展览纪念一位水下摄影先驱。

entries.en: My wool scarf shrank after I washed it in hot water.
entries.zh: 我的羊毛围巾用热水洗后缩水了。

entries.en: The rigid case protects the violin during long journeys.
entries.zh: 这个硬琴盒在长途旅行中保护小提琴。

entries.en: A peculiar smell of burnt sugar drifted from the kitchen.
entries.zh: 厨房里飘出一股烧焦糖的奇怪气味。

entries.en: Do not neglect the plants on the balcony while I am away.
entries.zh: 我不在时，别忘了照顾阳台上的植物。

entries.en: The fields of wheat turned golden in the late summer sun.
entries.zh: 夏末的阳光下，麦田变成了金黄色。

entries.en: Please circulate the revised agenda before tomorrow's meeting.
entries.zh: 请在明天开会前传阅修改后的议程。

entries.en: The bakery became profitable after it began taking orders for weddings.
entries.zh: 这家面包店开始承接婚礼订单后实现了盈利。

entries.en: The choir begins each rehearsal with a few vocal exercises.
entries.zh: 合唱团每次排练都先做一些发声练习。

entries.en: The new wall would deprive our garden of afternoon sunlight.
entries.zh: 新建的墙会让我们的花园失去午后的阳光。

entries.en: The furniture is stored in a warehouse beside the railway.
entries.zh: 这些家具存放在铁路旁的一座仓库里。

entries.en: A thorn had made a tiny hole in the bicycle tyre.
entries.zh: 一根刺在自行车轮胎上扎了一个小孔。

entries.en: The roar of the waterfall drowned out our conversation.
entries.zh: 瀑布的轰鸣声盖过了我们的谈话声。

entries.en: She carried a bucket of water from the tap to the vegetable patch.
entries.zh: 她从水龙头处提了一桶水去菜地。

entries.en: Leaving the only copy of the film on one hard drive seemed risky.
entries.zh: 把影片的唯一副本只放在一块硬盘上，似乎有些冒险。

entries.en: This compact desk fits neatly into the corner of my bedroom.
entries.zh: 这张小巧的书桌正好放进我的卧室角落。

entries.en: The organisers deployed extra volunteers near the busiest entrance.
entries.zh: 组织者在最繁忙的入口附近增派了志愿者。

entries.en: They embarked on a project to record the village's oral history.
entries.zh: 他们开始开展一个记录村庄口述历史的项目。

entries.meaningZh: 文学或艺术作品的类型
entries.en: She enjoys detective fiction but wants to try writing in another genre.
entries.zh: 她喜欢侦探小说，但想尝试写另一种类型的作品。

entries.en: The last train departs from platform four at ten thirty.
entries.zh: 末班火车十点半从四号站台发车。

entries.en: The age of the printer is irrelevant if it still meets our needs.
entries.zh: 只要打印机仍能满足我们的需要，它用了多久就无关紧要。

entries.en: The town planner showed us three possible designs for the square.
entries.zh: 城镇规划师向我们展示了广场的三种备选设计。

entries.en: A chunk of ice broke away from the edge of the frozen pond.
entries.zh: 一大块冰从结冰池塘的边缘断开。

entries.en: We made a crude model of the bridge from cardboard and string.
entries.zh: 我们用纸板和绳子做了一个粗糙的桥梁模型。

entries.en: The director summoned the cast for one final rehearsal.
entries.zh: 导演召集演员们进行最后一次排练。

entries.en: The narrow river wound through a jungle of tall trees and tangled vines.
entries.zh: 狭窄的河流蜿蜒穿过高树与藤蔓交织的丛林。

entries.en: Ants invaded the picnic basket while we were playing by the lake.
entries.zh: 我们在湖边玩耍时，蚂蚁大批爬进了野餐篮。

entries.en: The retailer agreed to display products made by local craftspeople.
entries.zh: 这家零售商同意陈列本地手艺人制作的产品。

entries.en: The documentary includes footage of the harbour before the hurricane arrived.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片包含飓风到来前港口的影像。

entries.en: The workshop asks students to become active participants rather than passive observers.
entries.zh: 工作坊要求学生积极参与，而不是被动旁观。

entries.en: Moving the radio away from the computer reduced the interference.
entries.zh: 把收音机移远一些，避开电脑，减少了干扰。

entries.en: Curiosity led her to open the dusty box in the attic.
entries.zh: 好奇心促使她打开了阁楼里那个满是灰尘的盒子。

entries.en: You can skip the introduction if you already know the basic rules.
entries.zh: 如果你已经知道基本规则，可以跳过引言。

entries.en: The two dogs greeted each other without any sign of aggression.
entries.zh: 两只狗互相打招呼，没有表现出任何攻击性。

entries.en: Her interest in journalism began when she edited the school newspaper.
entries.zh: 她编辑校报时，开始对新闻工作产生兴趣。

entries.en: The path widens just before it reaches the lake.
entries.zh: 这条小路快到湖边时变宽了。

entries.meaningZh: 使重新兴起或恢复活力
entries.en: The new owners hope to revive the cinema's tradition of weekend matinees.
entries.zh: 新业主希望恢复电影院周末日场放映的传统。

entries.en: The guide reassured us that there was plenty of time to catch the boat.
entries.zh: 导游让我们放心，说还有充足的时间赶船。

entries.en: I found the instructions confusing, and my partner was likewise puzzled.
entries.zh: 我觉得说明很难懂，我的搭档也同样困惑。

entries.en: A small white feather floated onto the surface of the pond.
entries.zh: 一根白色小羽毛飘落在池塘水面上。

entries.en: Dip the brush in water before mixing the next colour.
entries.zh: 调下一种颜色前，先把画笔在水里蘸一下。

entries.en: The sensor transmits a temperature reading every ten seconds.
entries.zh: 传感器每十秒传送一次温度读数。

entries.en: We bought fresh peaches from a stall beside the station.
entries.zh: 我们在车站旁的摊位买了新鲜桃子。

entries.en: He likes to boast about how quickly he can solve the puzzle.
entries.zh: 他喜欢夸耀自己解这道难题有多快。

entries.en: The revised timetable gives us ten minutes between the two lessons.
entries.zh: 修改后的课表在两节课之间留了十分钟。

entries.en: The lid fits tightly enough to keep the biscuits crisp.
entries.zh: 盖子盖得足够严实，可以让饼干保持酥脆。

entries.en: She unfolded the map across the bonnet of the car.
entries.zh: 她把地图展开铺在汽车引擎盖上。

entries.en: I tried to suppress a laugh when the puppy stole his slipper.
entries.zh: 小狗叼走他的拖鞋时，我努力忍住笑。

entries.en: The immense roof shelters the entire market from the rain.
entries.zh: 巨大的屋顶为整个市场遮雨。

entries.en: The locked cupboard aroused the children's curiosity.
entries.zh: 那个上锁的柜子引起了孩子们的好奇。

entries.en: Could you clarify whether the deadline is Friday morning or Friday evening?
entries.zh: 你能说清楚截止时间是周五早上还是周五晚上吗？

entries.en: A streak of blue paint ran down the side of the jar.
entries.zh: 一道蓝色颜料痕沿着瓶身流了下来。

entries.en: Each child made a paper decoration for the classroom window.
entries.zh: 每个孩子都为教室窗户做了一件纸装饰。

entries.en: We caught a glimpse of the sea between the passing buildings.
entries.zh: 透过掠过的楼房间隙，我们瞥见了大海。

entries.en: The cat sneaked into the cupboard while we were unpacking the groceries.
entries.zh: 我们整理买来的食品时，猫偷偷钻进了橱柜。

entries.en: A monkey balanced on the branch with a piece of fruit in its hand.
entries.zh: 一只猴子手拿水果，稳稳站在树枝上。

entries.en: We left the motorway to find a quieter place for lunch.
entries.zh: 我们驶离高速公路，找一个安静些的地方吃午饭。

entries.en: A careful listener noticed the change in the speaker's tone.
entries.zh: 一位细心的听众注意到了说话者语气的变化。

entries.en: Lightning briefly lit the hills beyond the darkened house.
entries.zh: 闪电短暂地照亮了漆黑屋子后方的群山。

entries.en: The cancelled ferry stranded us on the island for another night.
entries.zh: 渡轮取消，使我们又在岛上滞留了一夜。

entries.en: The character in the story looked away while receiving an injection.
entries.zh: 故事中的人物打针时把目光转向一旁。

entries.en: Our class compiled a guide to inexpensive places to eat near campus.
entries.zh: 我们班编写了一份校园周边平价餐馆指南。

entries.en: The fossil includes a curved rib from a large prehistoric animal.
entries.zh: 这件化石中有一根大型史前动物的弯曲肋骨。

entries.en: The children grew bored while the adults discussed paint colours.
entries.zh: 大人们讨论油漆颜色时，孩子们渐渐感到无聊。

entries.en: She joined the choir in March and attended every rehearsal thereafter.
entries.zh: 她三月加入合唱团，此后每次排练都参加了。

entries.en: The hotel room had a dreadful view of an overflowing rubbish bin.
entries.zh: 酒店房间外的景色糟透了，正对着一个满溢的垃圾桶。

entries.en: A loud bang from the kitchen made everyone stop talking.
entries.zh: 厨房传来一声巨响，大家都停止了交谈。

entries.en: Workers cleared fallen branches and other debris from the footpath.
entries.zh: 工人们清除了人行道上掉落的树枝和其他杂物。

entries.en: He flung his muddy boots into the corner of the porch.
entries.zh: 他把沾满泥的靴子扔到了门廊角落。

entries.en: The old chapel is still used for worship on Sunday mornings.
entries.zh: 这座老教堂如今仍在周日早上用于礼拜。

entries.en: A thin layer of ash covered the bottom of the fireplace.
entries.zh: 壁炉底部铺着一层薄灰。

entries.en: The longer opening hours have been beneficial to students with evening jobs.
entries.zh: 延长开放时间对晚上打工的学生有好处。

entries.en: She thrust the letter into my hand and hurried towards the train.
entries.zh: 她把信塞到我手里，匆匆朝火车走去。

entries.en: Our hunger grew as the smell of baking bread filled the house.
entries.zh: 烤面包的香气弥漫屋子时，我们越发觉得饿了。

entries.en: We amended the route to include a stop at the old mill.
entries.zh: 我们修改了路线，增加了在老磨坊停留的安排。

entries.en: Her comparative study examines how three schools organise lunchtime activities.
entries.zh: 她的比较研究考察了三所学校如何组织午间活动。

entries.en: The cottage was comfortable, albeit smaller than the photographs suggested.
entries.zh: 这间小屋住着舒服，虽然比照片显示的要小。

entries.en: A narrow path leads from the church to the village cemetery.
entries.zh: 一条窄路从教堂通向村里的墓地。

entries.en: The ferry carried bicycles as well as foot passengers across the bay.
entries.zh: 渡船把自行车和步行乘客一起运过海湾。

entries.en: Despite her growing fame, she still performed at the village festival.
entries.zh: 尽管名气越来越大，她仍在村里的节庆上演出。

entries.en: The editor returned the manuscript with notes in the margins.
entries.zh: 编辑退回了原稿，页边写着批注。

entries.en: There is little likelihood of finding an empty table before the concert ends.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束前，找到空桌的可能性很小。

entries.en: She grated a carrot into the salad for extra colour.
entries.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜擦成丝加入沙拉，增添一些颜色。

entries.en: The driver paid the toll before crossing the bridge.
entries.zh: 司机付了通行费才开车过桥。

entries.en: Each club has a quota of ten tickets for the opening night.
entries.zh: 每个社团分到的首演门票限额是十张。

entries.en: He blinked in the bright light as he stepped out of the cinema.
entries.zh: 他走出电影院时，被强光照得眨了眨眼。

entries.en: In the story, the reluctant heir turns the family mansion into a school.
entries.zh: 故事中，那位不情愿的继承人把家族宅邸改成了一所学校。

entries.en: Only current students are eligible to enter this campus photography contest.
entries.zh: 只有在校学生有资格参加这次校园摄影比赛。

entries.en: The round tabletop measures ninety centimetres in diameter.
entries.zh: 这个圆桌面的直径为九十厘米。

entries.en: A fox slipped through the hedge and vanished into the orchard.
entries.zh: 一只狐狸钻过树篱，消失在果园里。

entries.meaningZh: 躲避危险或不适的地方
entries.en: The bookshop became our refuge from the crowded streets.
entries.zh: 这家书店成了我们躲避街头拥挤的去处。

entries.en: There was a distinct chill in the air when we left the theatre.
entries.zh: 我们离开剧院时，空气中有一股明显的寒意。

entries.en: She steered the little boat between the two marker buoys.
entries.zh: 她驾驶小船从两个标记浮标之间穿过。

entries.en: The vase arrived intact despite the damage to its outer box.
entries.zh: 虽然外箱受损，花瓶送到时仍完好无损。

entries.en: The label on the fuel tank clearly says diesel.
entries.zh: 油箱上的标签清楚地写着柴油。

entries.en: These herbs thrive in the sunny corner beside the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 这些香草在厨房窗边向阳的角落长得很茂盛。

entries.meaningZh: 精心制作且细节繁多的
entries.en: The children built an elaborate castle from cardboard boxes.
entries.zh: 孩子们用纸箱搭了一座结构精巧的城堡。

entries.en: The goat chewed a mouthful of grass beside the fence.
entries.zh: 山羊在栅栏旁嚼着一口草。

entries.en: He ordered a steak with roasted vegetables.
entries.zh: 他点了一份配烤蔬菜的牛排。

entries.en: The referee paused the match while a loose net was repaired.
entries.zh: 球网松动，裁判暂停比赛让人修理。

entries.en: The fossil shows the delicate outline of a fern leaf.
entries.zh: 这块化石显现出蕨叶细致的轮廓。

entries.en: A deep scratch ran across the surface of the old table.
entries.zh: 旧桌子表面有一道深划痕。

entries.en: I was still awake when the first birds began to sing.
entries.zh: 第一批鸟开始鸣叫时，我还醒着。

entries.en: The dog curled up on a rug beside the armchair.
entries.zh: 狗蜷缩在扶手椅旁的小地毯上。

entries.en: Sprinkle a little cinnamon over the sliced apples.
entries.zh: 在切好的苹果片上撒一点肉桂粉。

entries.meaningZh: 值得某种评价或待遇的
entries.en: The student film is worthy of a much larger audience.
entries.zh: 这部学生电影值得让更多观众看到。

entries.en: It is doubtful whether we can fit all twelve chairs around this table.
entries.zh: 我们能否把十二把椅子都放在这张桌子周围，还很难说。

entries.en: She dictated the message while I typed it into the email.
entries.zh: 她口述消息，我把内容打进邮件里。

entries.en: A local patron paid for the restoration of the theatre's ceiling.
entries.zh: 一位本地赞助人出资修复了剧院天花板。

entries.meaningZh: 市政的；城市公共事务的
entries.en: The municipal swimming pool opens an hour earlier during summer.
entries.zh: 市立游泳池在夏天提前一小时开放。

entries.meaningZh: 无用的；不能发挥作用的
entries.en: The map was useless because it showed none of the new roads.
entries.zh: 这张地图一点用也没有，因为上面没有任何新路。

entries.en: The two families lived in harmony and shared the small garden.
entries.zh: 两家人和睦相处，共用那座小花园。

entries.en: The gallery rules forbid visitors to use flash photography.
entries.zh: 画廊规定禁止参观者使用闪光灯拍照。

entries.en: The teacher encouraged tolerance of different opinions during the debate.
entries.zh: 老师鼓励大家在辩论中包容不同意见。

entries.en: An experienced technician will supervise the students in the workshop.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的技术员将在工坊指导学生。

entries.en: A goat stood on the stone wall, watching us unpack the car.
entries.zh: 一只山羊站在石墙上，看着我们从车里卸行李。

entries.en: The narrator describes the misery of spending the night in wet clothes.
entries.zh: 叙述者描述了穿着湿衣服熬过一夜的痛苦。

entries.en: The scarf has a long fringe at each end.
entries.zh: 这条围巾两端都有长流苏。

entries.en: I sliced a banana over my bowl of porridge.
entries.zh: 我把一根香蕉切片，放在那碗粥上。

entries.en: She resisted the temptation to read the final page first.
entries.zh: 她忍住了先读最后一页的冲动。

entries.en: Underline the sentence that best supports your answer.
entries.zh: 在最能支持你答案的句子下面画线。

entries.en: The two reading groups merged when attendance began to fall.
entries.zh: 参加人数开始减少后，两个读书小组合并了。

entries.en: I marked the exhibition dates on the kitchen calendar.
entries.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了展览日期。

entries.en: Snowflakes clung to the traveller's thick beard.
entries.zh: 雪花粘在旅人浓密的胡须上。

entries.en: The actor sat on a wooden throne painted to look like gold.
entries.zh: 演员坐在一张漆成金色的木王座上。

entries.en: The driver braked gently as the traffic ahead slowed down.
entries.zh: 前方车流减速，司机轻轻踩了刹车。

entries.en: On impulse, I bought a ticket for the evening concert.
entries.zh: 我一时冲动，买了一张晚间音乐会的票。

entries.en: The novel depicts a brutal ruler who refuses to listen to his people.
entries.zh: 小说描绘了一位拒绝倾听民意的残暴统治者。

entries.en: The rabbit's fur felt soft beneath my fingertips.
entries.zh: 兔子的毛在我指尖下感觉很柔软。

entries.en: A persistent tapping noise kept interrupting our recording.
entries.zh: 持续的敲击声不断打断我们的录音。

entries.en: Two eagles soared above the ridge without moving their wings.
entries.zh: 两只鹰不扇动翅膀，在山脊上空翱翔。

entries.en: I was utterly amazed by the detail in the tiny model village.
entries.zh: 那个微型村庄模型的精细程度让我十分惊叹。

entries.en: The students enacted a scene from the play in the school courtyard.
entries.zh: 学生们在学校庭院里表演了这出戏的一个场景。

entries.en: A circular window brought afternoon light into the attic.
entries.zh: 一扇圆窗把午后的光线带进阁楼。

entries.en: She chose a dark green thread to mend the coat.
entries.zh: 她选了一根深绿色的线来补外套。

entries.en: The red clock tower is the most useful landmark for finding our street.
entries.zh: 要找我们那条街，红色钟楼是最好认的地标。

entries.en: We approached the fragile model with great caution.
entries.zh: 我们十分小心地靠近那个易碎的模型。

entries.en: An unpleasant smell lingered in the lift after the paintwork was finished.
entries.zh: 油漆工程完成后，电梯里仍留着难闻的气味。

entries.en: The puppy paused on the threshold before entering the unfamiliar room.
entries.zh: 小狗在门槛处停了停，才走进陌生的房间。

entries.en: We carried the chairs outside to enjoy the late afternoon sunshine.
entries.zh: 我们把椅子搬到外面，享受傍晚前的阳光。

entries.en: The motor turns a steel shaft connected to the fan.
entries.zh: 电动机带动一根与风扇相连的钢轴转动。

entries.en: The child spun the globe and pointed to a tiny island.
entries.zh: 孩子转动地球仪，指向一座小岛。

entries.en: The competition guidelines prescribe a maximum length of three minutes for each film.
entries.zh: 比赛指南规定，每部影片最长不得超过三分钟。

entries.en: The seminar explored questions of morality in traditional folk tales.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了传统民间故事中的道德问题。

entries.en: Common sense prevailed, and we postponed the picnic until the rain stopped.
entries.zh: 最终大家作出了明智决定，把野餐推迟到雨停以后。

entries.en: His firm denial surprised everyone who had seen him near the broken window.
entries.zh: 他坚决否认，这让所有见过他待在破窗附近的人都很惊讶。

entries.en: Finding rehearsal times that suit everyone has become a real headache.
entries.zh: 找一个适合所有人的排练时间成了真正的麻烦事。

entries.en: The monthly rental includes the use of a small storage room.
entries.zh: 月租中包括一间小储藏室的使用费。

entries.en: She looked at the ruined cake in despair before deciding to start again.
entries.zh: 她绝望地看着做坏的蛋糕，随后决定重新做。

entries.en: One loose screw was responsible for the chair's wobble.
entries.zh: 椅子晃动是因为一颗螺丝松了。

entries.meaningZh: 轮船等交通工具上的服务员
entries.en: The steward showed us where to leave our luggage on the ship.
entries.zh: 乘务员指给我们看船上放行李的地方。

entries.en: Her latest invention turns discarded jars into small indoor gardens.
entries.zh: 她最新的发明把废弃罐子变成了小型室内花园。

entries.en: He spoke with contempt about anyone who disagreed with his design.
entries.zh: 他谈起任何反对自己设计的人时，语气都带着轻蔑。

entries.en: The projection on the wall showed how the town had changed over a century.
entries.zh: 墙上的投影展示了这座城镇一个世纪以来的变化。

entries.en: The gardener left a basket of freshly cut herbs by the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 园丁在厨房门边放了一篮刚剪下的香草。

entries.en: The brochure contains a map of all the walking trails in the park.
entries.zh: 这本小册子里有一张标着公园所有步行道的地图。

entries.en: He borrowed a drill to make holes for the new shelf.
entries.zh: 他借了一把电钻，给新架子打安装孔。

entries.en: We had expected a quiet afternoon, but the contrary was true.
entries.zh: 我们本以为下午会很安静，实际情况却正好相反。

entries.en: The old mansion now houses a collection of clocks.
entries.zh: 那座旧宅邸现在用来陈列一批钟表。

entries.en: She keeps her jewellery in a small box lined with blue velvet.
entries.zh: 她把首饰放在一个内衬蓝色天鹅绒的小盒子里。

entries.en: A single grape rolled off the plate and under the table.
entries.zh: 一颗葡萄从盘子上滚落，滚到了桌子下面。

entries.en: Prospective students can tour the studios during the open day.
entries.zh: 有意入学的学生可以在开放日参观工作室。

entries.en: Only the project manager can authorize changes to the final design.
entries.zh: 只有项目经理能批准修改最终设计。

entries.en: He lost his temper when the printer jammed for the fifth time.
entries.zh: 打印机第五次卡纸时，他发了脾气。

entries.en: We passed through a stone arch into a quiet courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们穿过一道石拱门，进入安静的庭院。

entries.en: A yellow balloon floated above the crowd on a long string.
entries.zh: 一个黄色气球被长绳牵着，飘在人群上方。

entries.en: His large ego made it difficult for him to accept advice.
entries.zh: 他太自负，很难听进建议。

entries.en: The photograph was misleading because it made the tiny room look spacious.
entries.zh: 这张照片容易误导人，因为它把小房间拍得很宽敞。

entries.en: The ship's radar detected another vessel beyond the fog.
entries.zh: 船上的雷达探测到了浓雾另一边的一艘船。

entries.meaningZh: 刻有文字的石板或泥板
entries.en: The ancient clay tablet bears a list of grain deliveries.
entries.zh: 这块古代泥板上刻着一份粮食交付清单。

entries.en: We moved the sofa closer to the window for better reading light.
entries.zh: 我们把沙发移近窗户，让阅读时的光线更好。

entries.en: A pale mist hung over the river at sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出时，河面上笼罩着一层淡淡的薄雾。

entries.en: Twenty minus seven leaves thirteen seats available.
entries.zh: 二十减去七，还剩十三个空座位。

entries.en: She pulled a thick sweater over her shirt before going outside.
entries.zh: 出门前，她在衬衫外套了一件厚毛衣。

entries.en: His loud joke felt inappropriate during the quiet memorial gathering.
entries.zh: 在安静的纪念聚会上，他大声讲笑话显得不合适。

entries.en: We had insufficient rope to reach the far side of the hall.
entries.zh: 我们的绳子不够长，无法拉到大厅另一端。

entries.en: The wheels are covered with rubber to keep the trolley quiet.
entries.zh: 轮子外面包着橡胶，让手推车移动时更安静。

entries.en: The finished model must conform to the dimensions shown in the drawing.
entries.zh: 完成的模型必须符合图纸上标出的尺寸。

entries.en: The philosopher asked whether a happy life must also be a useful one.
entries.zh: 哲学家提出，一个幸福的人生是否也必须是有用的人生。

entries.en: In the story, the mistress of the house invites every servant to the feast.
entries.zh: 故事中，宅子的女主人邀请每一位仆人参加宴会。

entries.en: The number of unfamiliar tools overwhelmed me on my first day in the workshop.
entries.zh: 在工坊的第一天，那么多陌生工具让我不知所措。

entries.en: By evening, fatigue made it difficult to concentrate on the final chapter.
entries.zh: 到了晚上，疲劳使我难以集中精神读最后一章。

entries.en: Her noble aim was to make music lessons available to every child in the village.
entries.zh: 她的高尚目标是让村里每个孩子都能上音乐课。

entries.en: The game turns a simple mathematical pattern into a puzzle.
entries.zh: 这个游戏把一个简单的数学规律变成了一道谜题。

entries.en: The historian studied how travellers spread the gospel through the coastal towns.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究旅行者如何在沿海城镇传播福音。

entries.en: The minister preached to a small congregation in the village chapel.
entries.zh: 牧师在村里小教堂向一小群信众讲道。

entries.en: A monk opened the wooden gate and welcomed the travellers inside.
entries.zh: 一位僧侣打开木门，欢迎旅人入内。

entries.en: Her confession that she had never learned to swim surprised her friends.
entries.zh: 她坦白说自己从未学过游泳，这让朋友们很惊讶。

entries.en: Roll the cardboard into a cylinder and tape the edges together.
entries.zh: 把纸板卷成圆筒，用胶带粘住边缘。

entries.en: We archive the club's newsletters at the end of each term.
entries.zh: 每学期末，我们都会把社团简报存档。

entries.en: Each garment in the exhibition was sewn entirely by hand.
entries.zh: 展览中的每件服装都完全由手工缝制。

entries.en: The old textile factory has been converted into artists' studios.
entries.zh: 旧纺织厂已被改成艺术家的工作室。

entries.en: The report describes the physical trauma caused by the accident.
entries.zh: 报告描述了这次事故造成的身体创伤。
